conviction_note: A small negative lean. Q2 same-store sales turned negative against a very strong Q2 a year earlier, so H1 operating and ordinary profit will print down year on year. But that is visible in AEON's public monthly series, and the 1,745m yen quake special loss was pre-released on 9/28 (the stock fell 0.3% on it). What the release can still add is the FY net-profit decision (cut it, or hold it pending insurance, as in 2016). That decision is two-sided, so p_up is 46 on a 1.5% scale. The findings sum (-0.25) and the scaled number (-0.12) agree in sign.
bar: No sell-side consensus (IFIS shows no analyst forecast: https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_top&bcode=2653) and no published H1 plan. The bar is the company FY27/2 plan of OP 10,800m / ordinary 10,200m / NI 6,500m / dividend 50 yen (25+25), from the Q1 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260630585096.pdf). For H1 I use last year's H1 OP of 4,028m (37% of the FY) as the progress-rate reference. Shikiho is JS-only and unreadable, so the bar is company-only and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Kabutan lists it as buy-only for 制度信用 margin, so 信用倍率 reads '－' and there is no margin-short fuel (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2653). Turnover is thin, about 10-35k shares a day (about ¥35m). The stock has drifted from 2,841 (8/27) to 2,717 (10/13 09:53): -2.95% over 20 days. There is no skew because there are no options.

findings.finding: AEON's monthly table shows AEON Kyushu same-store sales of 96.8% in June, 101.0% in July and 101.4% in August (the July and August figures exclude 12 quake-closed stores). All-store sales were 98.5% / 101.6% / 100.7%. Q2 same-store sales therefore ran about 99.7%, against 103.6% a year earlier, when Q2 OP was about 3,474m (2.2x growth). H1 OP will likely print below last year's 4,028m. H1 ordinary profit will fall more, because last year's H1 ordinary of 5,177m included the one-off 差入保証金回収益, which produces a large 'H1 ordinary -30%-ish' kabutan headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last H1 (2025-10-14, 15:30) printed ordinary +75% with Q2 at 2.2x and the stock rose 3.24% the next day. The 2024-10-09 H1 print moved -1.05%. On Q1 2026-07-10 (ordinary -16%) the stock moved +0.21%. All from Yahoo closes at https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2653.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: AEON publishes this table on TDnet every month, and the stock has slid about 4% since late August with no other news, which is what a priced miss looks like. What is left is the headline mechanics. On a no-analyst name, the kabutan 'ordinary profit down sharply' line hits retail holders at the release, and the base-effect part of it (last year's deposit-recovery gain) is guided in the April deck but rarely read.
findings.independence: Data-max/NetIB monthly reports agree in direction: June down 3.2% (https://www.data-max.co.jp/article/85780, 2026-07-12); AEON Kyushu among the gainers in July and August (https://www.data-max.co.jp/article/86322, https://www.data-max.co.jp/article/86870). These are the same underlying company data, so they are not independent of the AEON table. The ordinary-profit base effect comes from the FY deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260408599933.pdf).

findings.finding: On 9/28 the company booked a 1,745m yen quake special loss in Q2, with more to come from Q3, against an unchanged FY NI plan of 6,500m. It said the FY impact was 'under review' and gave no revision. At this print it must either trim FY NI (after tax about 1.2bn, below the TSE 30% threshold that would have forced an earlier notice) or hold the plan pending insurance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 9/28 special-loss notice (17:00) moved the stock 2,790 -> 2,781 (-0.32%) on 9/29. The last FY revision (2026-03-24, an upgrade to a record) was followed by a -0.36% reaction to the FY print on 4/09.
findings.why_not_priced: The loss itself is priced (-0.3% on the day). What is not priced is the sign of the FY decision. If the market already assumes a cut, a held plan is a relief and a trimmed one is 悪材料出尽くし. That keeps this finding small and its range two-sided.
findings.independence: Kumanichi reported the same notice (https://kumanichi.com/articles/2040683, 2026-09-29), as did NetIB (https://www.data-max.co.jp/article/87148, 2026-09-30). All three rest on one document.

findings.finding: Precedent from the 2016 Kumamoto quake: AEON Kyushu booked a 1,181m yen special loss and then, in a 2016-09-21 notice, a 1,004m yen earthquake-insurance special gain in the same Q2, with the H1 forecast raised. The 9/28 notice this time says nothing about insurance, so the H1 release may carry an insurance gain or an 'insurance expected' statement that offsets the loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No price history fetched for 2016. This is snippet_only.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody covers the name, and the 9/28 notice framed the loss without any offset, so a holder reading only the notice prices a gross loss. If insurance were expected and priced, the stock would not have kept drifting after 9/28. It is still an inference: the PDF was fetched (HTTP 200) but its CID fonts could not be extracted, so the 1,004m figure is snippet_only and not load-bearing. Below operating income, so sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: A second search snippet cites the 2016 1,181m special loss and the insurance policy (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/26530/140120160706444230.pdf, which returned 404 here). Nothing from 2026 points the same way.

outside_window.finding: Further quake costs to be booked from Q3 onward (stated in the 9/28 notice), and possible insurance receipts after the print. Liability for the AEON Mall Kumamoto LP-gas explosion appears to sit with the mall operator and AEON's external committee; AEON Kyushu's 7/29 notice reported no serious injuries to its own staff.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible on FY NI only, to absorb the pre-released 1,745m loss; OP is probably held, sign uncertain. Returns: 25 yen interim already planned (up from 20, total flat at 50); there has been no buyback or 優待 change at any recent print, so none is expected. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter: H1 OP likely about 3.3-3.8bn, or 31-35% of the FY plan, against 37.5% (FY26) and 27% (FY25) at the same point, so it sits inside its own range; visible from the 月次.

rejected_candidates.detail: The investigation by METI and AEON's external committee is ongoing with no dated finding; any liability resolves after 10/14 and is carried in outside_window.

rejected_candidates.detail: A sector theme (2026-09-05) that this print does not resolve.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the -2.95% 20-day drift and the zero short register: the visible Q2 softness looks held in the price. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan plus an insurance offset, as in 2016. I looked for it, it is the third finding, and it is why p_up sits near 50 rather than at 40.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次): Q2 same-store-sales finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3, and p_up moved from 44 to 46
Rule 1, same logic for the pre-released special loss: guidance finding trimmed from -0.2 to -0.15, because only the forecast decision remains unpriced
Rule 2 (check for a positive): strongest positive named in baseline_tension; the insurance-precedent finding was already in the draft, so it is unchanged at +0.2
